title: AI & Intelligent Systems
summary: Intelligent applications, machine-learning workflows, and inference-oriented software designed around clear requirements and responsible engineering.
overview: AI capabilities become useful when they fit real workflows, operate within clear constraints, and can be evaluated beyond a compelling demo. Potential engagements may span application design, model integration, inference paths, and operational evaluation.
problems: Integrating AI into existing products and business workflows
Evaluating model or inference options against constraints
Designing reliable application boundaries around probabilistic outputs
Measuring latency, cost, and quality during prototyping

title: Cybersecurity & Digital Trust
summary: Security-minded application design, identity boundaries, access control, and practical trust mechanisms.
overview: Security is an engineering property that should be considered across architecture, implementation, operation, and maintenance. Scope depends on the system, threat model, data sensitivity, and operating environment.
problems: Clarifying trust between services and users
Improving secure defaults and operational visibility

title: Systems & Performance Engineering
summary: Systems software, profiling, resource efficiency, reliability, and CPU/GPU-aware optimization.
overview: Performance work begins with measurement and a defined workload. The aim is to understand bottlenecks, evaluate trade-offs, and improve the parts of a system where evidence supports change.
problems: Diagnosing CPU, memory, I/O, or GPU bottlenecks

title: Cloud & Software Engineering
summary: Backend services, APIs, application architecture, cloud infrastructure, deployment, and integration.
overview: Maintainable software connects product needs to clear interfaces, reliable delivery, and operational constraints. Engagements can focus on a component, an integration boundary, or an end-to-end technical foundation.
problems: Building or evolving backend services and APIs

title: Blockchain & Digital Infrastructure
summary: Carefully scoped blockchain-related applications, wallet integrations, and digital systems architecture.
overview: Distributed-ledger technology introduces distinctive trust, key-management, transaction, and operational concerns. Suitability should be assessed against the use case rather than assumed from the technology label.
problems: Assessing whether a distributed ledger fits a requirement
Defining application boundaries around external protocols

title: Autonomous & Embedded Systems
summary: Embedded software, robotics and UAV-related software, control interfaces, and system integration.
overview: Autonomous and embedded systems require careful attention to interfaces between software, hardware, sensing, control, and operational context. Work should be scoped around safety, validation needs, and available test environments.
problems: Integrating software components across device boundaries
Evaluating control, telemetry, or sensor interfaces

title: Research & Emerging Technology
summary: Technical investigation, experimentation, prototypes, feasibility studies, and architecture exploration.
overview: Research-oriented engineering creates a disciplined path from uncertainty to evidence. A useful outcome may be a tested hypothesis, a clear constraint, a prototype, or a decision to avoid an unsuitable approach.
problems: Documenting risks, trade-offs, and next steps
